scope: Authorized public-source research for local benchmark preparation. No paid model, account login, access restriction bypass, external data transfer or notice.

entries.source: Stanford Cable TV News Analyzer / Internet Archive TV News Archive
entries.finding: The public data page describes CNN, FOX and MSNBC coverage from 2010-01-01 through 2024-10-05, more than 380,000 hours, with closed captions for 97.9% of videos. The query documentation states that results are video-segment time, and supports fixed caption text, channels, date aggregation and normalization. This is a television-news propagation proxy, not public discussion or public sentiment.
entries.time_or_version_evidence: Current public documentation retrieved 2026-10-08; historical archive coverage period stated on the source page.
entries.access_result: Capability and scope verified from the public pages. No event-specific series was returned or saved: the direct query page was not accessible in the current research tool; a local HTTPS request to the data page failed certificate validation (expired certificate).
event_queries_attempted: Fidelity National Financial + cyberattack; 2023-11-16 through 2023-11-30, CNN/FOX/MSNBC
Blue Cross Louisiana + Elevance/sale; 2024-01-30 through 2024-02-13, CNN/FOX/MSNBC
entries.admission: No baseline/observation values available; no trend label.

entries.source: GDELT TV 2.0 API over Internet Archive captions
entries.finding: Official documentation describes a normalized timeline of the share of monitored 15-second television-caption clips matching a query, with fixed station and date filters. This is a propagation proxy only.
entries.time_or_version_evidence: API documentation accessed 2026-10-08; proposed query windows recorded in this log.
entries.access_result: Two event-specific timeline requests (FNF and Louisiana) failed before returning data with TLS unexpected EOF. A direct web-tool fetch of the FNF query URL also reported it inaccessible. No CSV or series values were retained; no retry through alternate access controls was attempted.
entries.admission: No baseline/observation values available; no trend label.

entries.finding: The v5 package already contains cutoff inputs and dated later public-discussion records for two distinct events (FNF cyber incident; BCBS Louisiana–Elevance transaction). The records are selected documents/posts, not exhaustive comparable counts.
entries.time_or_version_evidence: See qualified-inputs-v5.json and trajectory-evidence-v5.json; v5 source timestamps and fixed versions remain unchanged.
entries.access_result: No new event or comparable trend series admitted in this pass.
entries.admission: Both remain pilot inputs only; trajectory unknown.

constraints: A source access error is not evidence that no discussion occurred. Do not infer calm from absence of retrieved material. No future data is added to prediction inputs.
